gemini.title: Gemini API key
gemini.description: TickFlix's AI (the "Create a new timeline" panel) uses Google's Gemini. With your own key, usage is billed to your Google account instead of the platform's.
gemini.step1: Go to <1>Google AI Studio</1> and sign in with your Google account.
gemini.step3: Choose a Google Cloud project, or let AI Studio create one for you.
gemini.step4: Copy the generated key (starts with <1>AIza</1>) and paste it below.
gemini.usingUserKey: The AI is using your key.
gemini.usingPlatformKey: The AI is using the platform's default key.
gemini.footnote: The key is stored only in this browser. On another computer, you'll need to paste it again.
gemini.savedFeedback: Key saved. TickFlix's AI is now using your key.
gemini.removedFeedback: Key removed. The AI is back to using the platform's key.

about.heroTitle: Every timeline you want to watch, built by you.
about.heroLead: No categories to check off, no steps to follow. Describe what you want to watch in your own words, and TickFlix builds the real list — complete, with the right titles.

feature1.title: Timelines from a description
feature1.description: Write what you want to watch in free text — we understand the request and search for the real titles that match, no form in the way.

feature2.title: Track what you've watched
feature2.description: Mark each title as "Watched" and track each timeline's progress with a visual bar — always know how much is left.

feature3.title: In theaters and box office
feature3.description: See what's currently in theaters in Brazil and this year's box office champions, with the official trailer playing right on the home page.

feature4.title: Full details
feature4.description: Click any poster — from a timeline, a row, or search — to see the synopsis, cast, rating, genres, and director.

about.stepsHint: Four steps — and the first is the only one you actually type.

step1.title: Describe what you want to watch
step1.description: It can be an actor, a director, an entire franchise, a genre, a decade, a country, a studio — or a mix of all of that at once.

step2.title: Click "create timeline"
step2.description: That's it. No picking categories one by one, no intermediate screens.

step3.title: The search happens for real
step3.description: Your request becomes real search criteria against the catalog — not a list made up from memory. If you don't ask for a specific amount, the timeline comes back complete.

step4.title: Watch and track your progress
step4.description: Mark "Watched" on each title as you go and keep track of how far you've come.
